items.title: PHYSINT - Official Cast Reveal Video | Xbox TGS 2026 Broadcast
items.description:
Xbox surprised us with one more thing at the end of their TGS Broadcast. A catchup with Hideo Kojima as he talks about the cast members for PHYSINT, the all new espionage action game from the mind of the man who started it all. 

PHYSINT is still a ways off but we now know the lead character will be played by Bill Skarsgaard, with supporting cast members: Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe!
